name: moodle-clockify
description: Clockify time tracking integration for Claude Desktop. Log time, check running timers, and manage time entries.

clockify_api_key.title: Clockify API Key
clockify_api_key.description: Your personal API key from app.clockify.me → Profile Settings → API section.

clockify_workspace_id.title: Clockify Workspace ID
clockify_workspace_id.description: Found in app.clockify.me → Settings → General. It's the long ID in your workspace URL.
